description: The PriorAuthBot golden set over samples/documents (synthetic, no real PHI). Chapter 7 wrote 20 questions, chapter 8 added 4 exact-term questions, and chapter 9 grows it to 105. kind is fact, exact-term, permission, or out-of-scope; chapter is the chapter that added the case. expectedDocuments must be retrieved; mustNotSee documents must never be retrieved for that user; expectDecline means PriorAuthBot must say it does not know; answerMustContain and answerMustNotContain are checked on the live answer; expectedAnswer is the ground truth for the completeness judge; answerEval marks the sample whose answers are scored by the LLM judges in CI.
